review_scope: Read-only inspection of four requested delivery files against official selection record and bounded scalar arithmetic. Only this new review JSON is written.

checks.detail: 24 V 15 A is the Seeed DM setup PSU reference; actual arm task peak remains unmeasured.
RSP-500-24 is external ground support. No onboard or flight credit.
Matches official RSP PDF p.3; selected individual terminals remain blank; CN100 excluded from main current.
6 A remains the battery public module limit, not an available whole-EPS allocation. Complete Dock option and shared-load limits are unclosed; no arm load assigned here.
Two i7C-PC3 modules remain future integration reference, not BPX-powered 15 A arm path.
Destination contacts, cable gauge, cut lengths, grounding/isolation and regeneration are unknown, not zero or complete.
4 rows, each with 12 columns; two power nets and two CAN signal nets.
DM CAN and legacy MiPS RS-422 are separated; no physical pin inferred from CAN address or family name.
3.65 N m s / 44 N s = 0.0829545454545 m. This is an ideal necessary scalar bound, not the spacecraft actual lever arm.
All 4 cases reproduce r*44, r*5*0.01 and 3.65/tau in m, N s, N, s. No 82 N s or 25 mN substitution found.
Optimistic all-jet torque/time arithmetic is not a demonstrated simultaneous firing capability, actual wrench, translation cancellation or mission-time guarantee.
No hardware, fabrication, flight, dynamics or scientific-Gate completion invented.
Document count 82 matches EMISSION_V6 parts. This verifies count only, not geometry/assembly validity; linked selection document exists.

nonblocking_observations.recommendation: For self-contained future machine consumption, consider adding explicit reference_part=X14029003-1, total_impulse_Ns=44, nozzle_count=5, individual_reference_thrust_N=0.01 and source hash. Current old-model binding is conveyed in notes and surrounding selected architecture; numerical values correctly reproduce the old source.
nonblocking_observations.reason: Provenance and assumptions are easier to audit when encoded as inputs; no present mixed-generation numerical error found.

nonblocking_observations.recommendation: When presenting the ideal time bound, always retain that five reference thrusts were summed optimistically and that joint firing/manifold capability and vector alignment are not established.
nonblocking_observations.reason: Current scalar-only status and unknown wrench correctly withhold mission capability; a downstream chart must not lose these qualifications.
